The single created rows (group, user, membership, incident) are anchored by the next id in each sequence, where the benchmark checks select by name or description; a duplicate group or user passes the anchored requirement but fails the benchmark's by-name count of 1. The two notifications are selected by incident and recipient. The benchmark's verify_david_park_user_created description says 'NYC location', but its query tests LOC_001, which is ACME HQ in Santa Clara and matches the request; the query stands. The policy's mandatory opened_by has no incident column, and caller_id is not tested because the request names no affected user. user_role is not tested: users.role carries the agent role and the request mentions roles only in 'new agent'. The acting user USER_039 (Karen Watkins) is an active admin, so no permission rule blocks any step.
